club.label: Doors open / check-in
club.description: Self check-in at race control. Tick your name off before practising.

club.label: Open practice
club.description: The track opens when the race director says, normally at 08:30. Open practice runs until 09:30.

club.label: Controlled practice
club.description: 3-minute controlled practice following the drivers’ briefing.

club.label: Qualifying
club.description: Qualifying follows controlled practice, normally after a 5-minute break.

club.label: Finals
club.description: The usual 10-minute break after qualifying allows the finals to be sorted, listings to be printed and drivers to fit a number to their car.

club.label: Track pack-away
club.description: Any help to pack the track away is appreciated. Many hands make light work.

sword.label: Doors open / check-in
sword.description: Self check-in at race control. Tick your name off before practising.

sword.label: Controlled practice
sword.description: 3-minute controlled practice. First practice on the line normally at 08:50. No open practice.

sword.label: Qualifying
sword.description: With 12 heats, qualifying starts straight after controlled practice, as each round takes approximately 1 hour 20 minutes. With fewer heats, there is some flexibility in the timing.

sword.label: Finals
sword.description: The usual 10-minute break after qualifying allows the finals to be sorted, listings to be printed and drivers to fit a number to their car.

sword.label: Awards and photographs
sword.description: Award boards for the top three in each final. We aim to take photographs of the top three once they have completed their marshalling duties.

sword.label: Track pack-away
sword.description: Any help to pack the track away is appreciated. Many hands make light work.
